subject.title: feat: show build identity chip (commit + age + branch) in sidebar footer

question: Should permanent sidebar chrome show the Control UI artifact commit and age for all builds while keeping gateway checkout branch state separate?
rationale: The linked maintainer-protected issue changes the information hierarchy for every Control UI user; code correctness cannot determine whether this diagnostic belongs permanently in release-build sidebar chrome.

options.title: Separate artifact chip
options.body: Show the UI artifact commit and age as a muted About link while retaining the gateway checkout branch strip as a distinct warning.

options.title: Limit to source builds
options.body: Render the chip only for development, dirty, or non-main artifacts and leave release builds with the About-page surface.

options.title: Retain current surfaces
options.body: Keep artifact identity in About and the development tooltip, with only gateway branch state persistently visible.

recommendation.title: Separate artifact chip
recommendation.body: Show the UI artifact commit and age as a muted About link while retaining the gateway checkout branch strip as a distinct warning.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current identity surfaces and opened both the linked request and implementation PR.
